title: Saudi Buckwheat Tagine
description: A unique fusion of Saudi and Mexican flavors, this tagine recipe incorporates the earthy taste of buckwheat. Perfect for a flavorful and nutritious meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add buckwheat groats and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add dates, cumin, and tagine spice blend. Mix well.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until buckwheat is tender.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
